pages.text: $(thing)Aquaculture 2$() replaces plain fishing with dozens of fish across the ocean, rivers, swamps and cold waters, and with rods, hooks, bait and lines you can swap.

pages.title: Iron Fishing Rod
pages.text: Rods come in Iron, Golden, Diamond and Neptunium. A better rod tolerates better hooks.

pages.title: Tackle Box
pages.text: Holds hooks, line, bobber and bait in one place. Hooks have effects: Heavy, Light, Double, Redstone, Note, Glowstone, Quartz, Soul Sand, Obsidian and Nether Star.

pages.title: Worm Farm
pages.text: Makes Worms, the standard bait. Fish are caught with bait on the line.

Catches include cod, halibut, herring, salmon, pollock, trout, bass, catfish, piranha, arapaima, tuna, jellyfish and several turtles. Plenty come in a bucket, so they can be moved. Fillet them with a $(item)Fillet Knife$() for meat that cooks well.

pages.title: Neptunium Ingot
pages.text: Rare fishing loot. Neptunium makes tools, armor and a bow, and can be smelted back from them.

pages.title: Neptune's Bounty
pages.text: A box of Neptunium loot, made from Neptunium ingots.

Cooking: Aquaculture Delight and Ocean's Delight turn catches into meals, see $(l:ocean/sea_food)Sea Food$(/l). Hybrid Aquatic and Naturalist add their own fish, and Hybrid's hooks work for rare ones: see $(l:ocean/sea_life)Sea Life$(/l).
